(rule!
 ;; Paint a gray(5) diagonally DOWN-LEFT of every maroon(9) — checked against
 ;; the ACCUMULATING grid, so earlier paints block later ones.
 (for/fold ((out g)) ((p (in-list (find-color g 9))))
   (let ((rr (+ (first p) 1)) (cc (- (second p) 1)))
     (if (and (in-bounds? rr cc h w) (= (at out rr cc) 0))
         (set-cell out rr cc 5)
         out))))
